Top 10: Fleet Telematics Providers

2026-08-05 Louise Collins, Supply Chain Digital fleet telematics, GPS tracking, vehicle diagnostics, driver behavior, logistics optimization, Geotab, Samsara, Verizon Connect, TomTom Webfleet, AI safety
Read the source article

Quick summary

Supply Chain Digital ranks the top 10 fleet telematics providers, from Geotab's 100-billion-data-point processing to Samsara's real-time GPS tracking — companies using GPS, diagnostics, and AI to drive safety, efficiency, and sustainability across logistics operations.

Key takeaways

  • Geotab leads the ranking with 25+ years of experience, processing over 100 billion data points daily for 54,999+ companies, offering custom reports and automated compliance
  • Samsara (#2) provides full visibility across vehicles, powered/unpowered assets, temperature, and driver actions with real-time GPS tracking and app-based workflows
  • Verizon Connect (#3) enables near-time vehicle visibility, fuel waste detection, and route history replay for proof-of-operations verification
  • The ranking covers diverse capabilities: AI-powered fatigue detection (Lytx), integrated IoT platforms (PowerFleet), and 20+ unsafe behavior detection at 99% accuracy (Motive)
  • TomTom's Webfleet (#10) rounds out the list with vehicle tracking for trucks, vans, cars, and trailers, including driving style monitoring and fuel/battery insights
